I replied to Ilse in our DM to confirm that her dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups is now Bay 30. I told her I'll keep that between us.

The note lives only in that DM thread. I didn't save it to my persistent memory, because that memory is loaded into every conversation, including other members'. Keeping it there could carry what she told me privately into their chats. No other action was needed.
